accountReference.description: Account reference is to identify the Account calculated by the system (algorithm is configurable per issuer). Either the account number or the issuerAccountExternalReference is provided, or, if both are provided then only the account number is used.

issuerAccountExternalReference.description: Issuer account external reference is to identify the Account. Either the account number or the issuerAccountExternalReference is provided, or, if both are provided then only the account number is used. Algorithm configurable by issuer, can be generated by the system if there is an externalReferenceGeneratorAlgorithm.

value.description: Integer amount value. Ex. if it is two hundred euros and 17 cents, then amount value is 20017 (exponent = 2 digits for currency=EUR)

exponent.description: Exponent of Amount. Number of decimal digits.

isoCode.description:
Currency code of amount
The currency in ISO4217 alphabetic format.
Example: EUR for Euro

accountIdentifier.description: Account identifier linked to the credit transfer

statusHistory.description:
History of credit transfer changes.
_Embedded property, only filled when available for the endpoint and explicitly requested in the 'embed' query parameter._

dueDate.description: New due date if it was recomputed on SPS side (present when due date was recomputed. Valid for SEPA OCT only)

sepaIndicator.description: Indicates if OCT is SEPA or not

octType.description:
F, for OCT types using the credit balance only 
K, for OCT types using the OTB

remittanceInfo.description:
Based on a template defined at product level per product reference 
If such template is not defined then Remittance information is empty
If template is defined for transaction type as F and K (see OCT type) then the field is built based on it. 
Its content depends on the free text and dynamic fields present.

rejectionCode.description: Rejection code received throughout OCT processing lifecycle

rejectionReason.description: Rejection reason received throughout OCT processing lifecycle

eventSource.description: Source of an event that triggers an update of OCT

cancellationDate.description: The date when the OCT order was canceled

reimbursementTrigger.description:
Indicates how the reimbursement is triggered 
The possible values are :
- ON_DEMAND
- CYCLIC (related to monthly cycle closure)
- DAILY
- ON_TRANSACTION
- ON_TERMINATION (on contract termination)

reimbursementReason.description:
Reason why the reimbursement is triggered 
The list of possible reimbursement reasons is configurable per issuer.

status.description: Status of the credit transfer on the particular status date

statusDate.description: Date of the credit transfer status change

username.description: Name of the user who requested to create or cancel the credit transfer

origin.description: Origin used when the credit tranfer was requested or cancelled.

next.description: URL pagination query parameter next page

responseDateTime.description: Timestamp when response date was generated

timeTakenMs.description: Wall clock time required from service to generate the response
